prompt: I found two connector profiles in my project when I expected one. How can I see which linked accounts are using which connector profile?
skill_note: Accounts and connector profiles are platform territory.

fetch.name: fetches-v2-accounts-reference
fetch.note: The v2 accounts reference carries connector_profile_id.

reply.name: uses-connector-profile-id
reply.note: The field that links an account to its profile.

reference: The v2 List Accounts endpoint returns connector_profile_id on each account.
List Accounts accepts a connector_profile_id filter, so the accounts on one profile can be listed directly.
The reply does not invent an audit or profile-usage endpoint that the reference does not list.
